verdict.rationale: Zulip provides extensive first-party documentation for self-hosting: an installer that lets you run the software on your own server with the same codebase as Zulip Cloud, plus import/export tools to migrate between hosted and self-hosted deployments, and an open-source GitHub repo for contributing to the core product. Community evidence partially corroborates self-hosting is real and used in production (e.g., open-source project hosting) but one comment notes server installation 'is a mess,' a minor caveat. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of a smooth self-hosting setup experience at scale.
